newsitem.title: USA: Eli Lilly, Pharmagenesis enter R&D pact.
newsitem.headline: Eli Lilly, Pharmagenesis enter R&D pact.

text.p: Pharmagenesis Inc and Eli Lilly and Co said on Thurasday they had agreed to cooperate on research and development aimed at isolating and developing antifungal agents derived from microorganisms associated with plants known to be resistant to fungal infections.

The EcoPharm division of Palo Alto, Calif.-based Pharmagenesis will isolate plant-associated microorganisms and any biological compounds that demonstrate antifungal activity. Lilly will handle preclinical and clinical development of lead compounds from the collaboration.

Pharmagenesis will receive support and milestone payments, and retains all antifungal product rights in China, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Macau, Malaysia, Hong Kong and Indonesia. Lilly will retain antifungal product rights for all other parts of the world, the companies said.

In addition, Lilly will retain all other product rights to applications for cardiovascular diseases, central nervous system diseases, cancer, infectious diseases, and hormonal disorders discovered from microorganisms isolated by EcoPharm.
Further terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

Lilly is one of the largest U.S. drug makers. Pharmagenesis is a privately held drug development firm focused on novel pharmaceuticals and nutra-ceuticals derived from herbal remedies employed in traditional Chinese medicine.
